'''Detective Drizzile!''' (Japanese: '''狙われたサクラギ研究所！''' ''The Targeted {{tt|Sakuragi Institute|Cerise Laboratory}}!'') is the twenty-second chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN078|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Goh]] is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Nidoran♀}} and a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Nidoran♂}}.
* Goh's {{p|Sobble}} is revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Drizzile}}.
* Goh's Drizzile evolves into {{TP|Goh|Inteleon}} and learns {{m|Snipe Shot}}.

===Debuts===
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Nidoran♀}} 
* {{p|Nidoran♂}} 
* {{p|Drizzile}} 
* {{p|Inteleon}} 
* {{p|Kecleon}}

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}})
* {{p|Darmanitan}} ({{OP|Goh|Darmanitan}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Darmanitan|Standard Mode}})
* {{p|Nidoran♀}} ({{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Nidoran♀|Goh's}})
* {{p|Nidoran♂}} ({{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Nidoran♀|Goh's}})

* {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]])
* {{p|Kecleon}} ([[Gizmo Bilt|Gizmo]]'s)

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* As the events of ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]'' and ''[[JN062|Not Too Close for Comfort!]]'' were skipped, [[Goh]]'s {{p|Nidoran♀}}, {{p|Nidoran♂}}, and {{TP|Goh|Drizzile}} debut here.
* This chapter was released before ''[[JN078|Detective Drizzile!]]'' first aired in Japan, spoiling Drizzile's [[Evolution]].
